notes: The two heads (Imran through Shu'ayb; Ibrahim through Hajjaj) meet at Ibn Jurayj, and the text writes the rest once after «قال ابن جريج أخبرني» for both, so it is the shared tail.
«- يعني ابن إسحاق -» is a gloss, left out.
«رجل، من أهل العراق يقال له شقيق بن سلمة أبو وائل» is an unnamed man the text then names, so he is Shaqiq (rule 8).
Sabi and Umar speak inside the story (Sabi's words, Umar's answer), so each is a link (rule 6). «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter (rule 2).
«قال شقيق وكنت أختلف» is Shaqiq's own remark, left out.
